resolution.note: Budget entries are blank-line separated; test enforces it and replays two adjacent bumps through git merge-file.

title: Let parallel lanes bump instruction budgets without merge conflicts
body:
Outcome: parallel lanes that bump different entries of spec/context-budget.json merge without conflicts.
Why: on 2026-11-09 the t-7g0prdk lane (#504) rebased twice, once on spec/context-budget.json, because lanes editing different skills bump adjacent budget lines; git conflicts on adjacent line changes.
Proof: entries are blank-line separated, enforced by test/rules/instruction-bytes.test.ts; a git merge-file replay of two adjacent bumps merges cleanly.
Scope: spec/context-budget.json, test/rules/instruction-bytes.test.ts.
